title: Make it blink
brief: BOSS. Everything from levels 5–9 in one circuit, plus one new wire. Build it in stages, and power up after each to check it.
Stage 1, the chip (level 7): pins 8 and 4 to +, pin 1 to −. The output, pin 3, through R3 to the LED.
Stage 2, the clock (levels 6 and 9): C1 from pin 6 to −. R1 from + to pin 7, R2 from pin 7 to pin 6. C1 fills through R1 + R2 and drains through R2 into pin 7.
Stage 3, the new wire: join pin 2 (TRIGGER) to pin 6. Every time C1 drains to ⅓ of the supply, the chip re-triggers itself: a one-shot that never stops.
lesson: f ≈ 1.44 ÷ ((R1 + 2·R2) × C) = 1.44 ÷ ((10k + 136k) × 10 µF) ≈ 1 Hz. Bigger C or R2, slower blink.
